scope: install-time pruning, binding, match policy and epoch invalidation implemented in HookEnvironment/ReflectiveMemberResolver

fixtures.contract: process pruning happens before capability checks and installation
required capability not SUPPORTED_IN_DECLARED_CELL refuses install
UNKNOWN (including undeclared keys) is never promoted to supported
UNIQUE with several overloads returns AMBIGUOUS_TARGET and installs nothing
FIRST uses a stable signature ordering rather than VM reflection order
declared return type participates in matching and static return checks
synthetic/bridge methods are not resolved as hook targets
same class name in different loaders yields different Member identities even with identical loader display names
a code epoch change during install discards the unpublished plan
duplicate logicalId is idempotent only for identical full semantics; otherwise CONFLICT without overwrite
close reports observed in-flight leases and never replays the original; racing calls fall through exactly once

not_implemented: resolution caching and epoch-aware negative cache reuse (no cache exists in this slice)
